summary: Iteration 15 retested the Admin Stage 2 follow-ups. Backend: test_iter15_admin_followups.py has 6 tests and test_iter14_admin.py has 6; all 12 pass. GET /admin/me returns 401 for anonymous, 200 super_admin for demo and 403 for mailtest. The test ran promote_configured_admins() against the app DB: an env-sourced admin whose email is no longer listed was demoted (both fields unset), a manual role with no source was kept, and demo kept super_admin with no source. Frontend: anonymous /admin/users redirects to /login?next=%2Fadmin%2Fusers (PASS). After logging in as demo, the user lands on /today instead of /admin/users (FAIL, 3 of 3 runs). A plain login goes to /today, and next=//evil.com, https://evil.com and /\evil.com all go to /today (PASS). The Provider cost card shows ₹602.20, and the hint 'Date filters apply once live data is connected.' is visible (PASS). On mobile (390px) the admin-role block shows 'Signed in as demo / Super Admin / ← Back to app', the Back link goes to /today, and there is no horizontal overflow (PASS). mailtest /auth/me returns 200, and /today loads for demo. There were no page errors.

minor.issue: Users promoted by env before admin_role_source existed have a role but no source, so they will never be demoted. A one-off migration may be needed if any exist (demo is a deliberate manual role).

integration_issues.issue: The next param is ignored and the user always lands on /today. Root cause: app/(auth)/layout.tsx has an effect that runs as soon as status becomes 'authenticated' on a public path. It calls router.replace(profile.onboardingCompleted ? '/today' : '/onboarding') and renders null, so the LoginPage replace to next loses the race or never happens. Fix: in AuthGroupLayout, read useSearchParams().get('next') and use the same safe-path check as the target when onboarding is complete. Alternatively, move the safe-next helper into a shared util that both use. This also fixes visiting /login?next=... while already signed in.

issues: Carry-over: the nav bar that scrolls sideways does not scroll the active item into view (for example /admin/usage)

action_items: Fix app/(auth)/layout.tsx so it respects a safe ?next= when redirecting an authenticated user away from /login (it currently always goes to /today)
critical_code_review_comments: The safe-next check in login-page.tsx (/^\/[a-z0-9/_-]*$/i) also drops legitimate query strings and dots (for example /admin/users?q=x). That is acceptable, but put it in a shared helper because the (auth) layout needs it too
The redirect logic is duplicated across LoginPage and AuthGroupLayout, which is what causes the race. Keep a single owner for post-login navigation
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_env_*/TEST_man_* users were inserted and deleted inside test_iter15
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://5909486e-7c4f-4b5e-a629-9625f993ed88.preview.emergentagent.com when running pytest (frontend/.env points to another host). To retest next: clear cookies, goto /admin/users, wait for **/login?next=**, fill input[name=email]=demo and input[name=password]=DemoPass123!, submit, then expect /admin/users and [data-testid=admin-users-table].
rca of the issue: Steps to reproduce: as an anonymous user open /admin/users, which goes to /login?next=%2Fadmin%2Fusers, then log in as demo. The user lands on /today (3 of 3 runs). Cause: AuthGroupLayout's useEffect runs on status=authenticated with isPublic, and router.replace('/today') overrides LoginPage's router.replace(next). Fix: make the layout honour a safe next.
